trajectory.development: The Series could open with the bond-keeping practices working as they always have: families sustaining friendships across migrations through markets, celebrations, craft and generosity, while the regularity still holds. This is d2 shown before it is tested.
trajectory.becomes_available: The author vision states these practices and that communities have learned to live with migrations; that earlier condition lets the practices be shown as functioning, not only as threatened.
trajectory.changes: Gives d1's later failure a measured weight: the reader knows what the practices accomplished before the pattern broke, so the test named in E6 has a visible baseline.
trajectory.quote: Families maintain friendships across changing seas.

trajectory.development: The one trusted regularity fails: an inhabited island does not return when expected (d1). Every known island had eventually reappeared within its cycle, so this is a break in the pattern, not one more migration.
trajectory.becomes_available: The recorded regularity that every inhabited island eventually reappeared is what makes the non-return a failure rather than ordinary unpredictability.
trajectory.changes: Turns the practices of d2 from a way of life into a question of survival, and turns d3 from a curiosity into a pressing need for an answer.
trajectory.quote: This year, one inhabited island does not return when expected.

trajectory.development: The bond-keeping practices are tested by the disappearance, producing repeated action families of reaching out, keeping faith and repairing (d2 under d1's pressure).
trajectory.becomes_available: The recorded link states the engine tests whether bond-keeping practices can survive a broken pattern; d1's failure is the condition that makes this test possible.
trajectory.changes: Makes d1 felt as loss among people before it is a puzzle, and gives the Series a renewable family of actions that does not depend on any explanation being found.
trajectory.quote: tests whether bond-keeping practices can survive a broken pattern

trajectory.development: Attempts to explain, exploit, mourn or reverse the failure generate pressure, action and revelation; the disappearance gives rise to competing interpretations.
trajectory.becomes_available: d1's summary names these four responses to the failure; the author vision names competing interpretations as a consequence of the disappearance.
trajectory.changes: Places explanation (d3) as one response among several rather than the only one, so mourning and exploitation can carry Books in which explanation advances little.
trajectory.quote: every attempt to explain, exploit, mourn or reverse that failure generates pressure, action and revelation

trajectory.development: If partial answers are reached, each could reopen what else communities assumed was stable, widening the test of bonds from the missing island to other relationships and other assumed regularities.
trajectory.becomes_available: d1 is recorded as renewable because each partial answer reopens assumptions; this follows only once some partial answer exists.
trajectory.changes: Recasts earlier bond-keeping as having rested on assumptions now in doubt, so earlier practices gain retrospective meaning without being invalidated.
trajectory.quote: Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

trajectory.development: Proposed: the final degree of explicability (d3) is settled late, as one of fully explicable, partially understood or enduringly mysterious. The record does not choose; this stage assumes the choice is left until the bonds have been tested.
trajectory.becomes_available: The question itself is recorded as open about how far the migrations should be explained by the end.
trajectory.changes: Whichever answer is chosen reframes what the earlier responses meant: full explanation makes them steps toward an answer; enduring mystery makes the bonds themselves the answer.
trajectory.quote: How far should the migrations be explained by the end: fully explicable, partially understood, or enduringly mysterious?

relations.reason: The recorded link states d1 tests d2; the action families of reaching out, keeping faith and repairing are produced by the disappearance. d2's practices exist without d1, but their test does not.
relations.quote: The disappearance tests whether those practices can adapt, producing repeated action families of reaching out, keeping faith and repairing.

relations.reason: Inferred: d1's renewal depends on partial answers reopening assumptions. A fully explicable answer to d3 would tend to close that renewal; a partial or mysterious answer keeps it open. d3's answer therefore constrains how long d1 can run.
relations.quote: Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

relations.reason: Migrations were unpredictable before the failure, so the question of explicability does not require d1; but d1 makes explanation pressing by naming explanation as one response to the failure.
relations.quote: Their migrations are unpredictable, but generations of communities have learned to live with them.

relations.reason: Not stated in the cited items that the bond practices depend on any explanation of the migrations. Communities learned to live with unpredictable migrations, so bond-keeping can succeed or fail whatever answer d3 receives.
relations.quote: Their migrations are unpredictable, but generations of communities have learned to live with them.

relations.reason: The bonds give the failure its human stakes: the consequences fall on people whose lives depend on the shifting geography, and d2 names the practices through which those lives hold together.
relations.quote: consequences for people whose lives depend on the shifting geography.

alternative_paths.ordering: Explicability first: d1's failure is followed early by sustained attempts to explain the migrations (d3 developed early), and the bonds (d2) are tested afterward, once some account of the migrations exists.
alternative_paths.effect: Easier: a clear investigative spine and early revelation. Harder: loss risks reading as a puzzle before it is felt, and the absence of a shown baseline weakens the test of d2. Emphasises curiosity. Early full explanation would close d1's renewal; early partial explanation keeps it open.
alternative_paths.quote: Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

alternative_paths.ordering: Bonds first: d2's practices are established, then d1's failure tests them, so the loss is felt before its explanation is sought; d3 is advanced slowly and settled late.
alternative_paths.effect: Easier: emotional weight and a stable baseline for E6's test; d3's answer stays open longest. Harder: slower early momentum and a risk that explanation feels deferred. Emphasises loss and faith. Keeps all three d3 answers open, including enduring mystery.
alternative_paths.quote: Traveling markets, seasonal celebrations, shared craftsmanship, and acts of generosity help people sustain relationships even when familiar places become distant.

alternative_paths.ordering: Interleaved: each Book advances one partial answer to d3, and each partial answer reopens another assumed stability that the bonds of d2 must then absorb.
alternative_paths.effect: Uses d1's recorded renewal directly; explanation and bond-testing alternate. Risk: repetition if each reopening is not distinct. It presupposes the answer to d3 is not fully explicable early.
alternative_paths.quote: Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

opportunities.text: Proposed: explanation itself could travel through the bond practices. Competing interpretations of the disappearance would spread through markets and celebrations, so the networks that sustain bonds also carry disagreement, and keeping faith may mean keeping faith across rival explanations.
opportunities.quote: The disappearance creates uncertainty, opportunities, competing interpretations, and consequences for people whose lives depend on the shifting geography.

opportunities.text: Inferred: keeping faith with the unreturned island is a bond practice aimed at a place that cannot answer. Whether that faith is mourning, hope or refusal is something neither the failure nor the practices settle alone.
opportunities.quote: every attempt to explain, exploit, mourn or reverse that failure generates pressure, action and revelation

opportunities.text: Inferred: if each partial answer reopens what else was assumed stable, every advance on d3 extends the test of bonds from one island to relationships that had seemed safe, so understanding and vulnerability grow together.
opportunities.quote: Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

reader_experience: Under the bonds-first order the reader first knows how the archipelago holds itself together, then feels the non-return as a loss among people, and only afterward meets explanation as one response among mourning, exploitation and reversal. Under the explicability-first order the reader is drawn by the puzzle and meets the bonds as the cost of the answer. In either order, early Books can stand on what the practices achieve or fail to achieve, whatever d3's eventual answer.
open_decisions: Which answer to d3 the Series moves toward: fully explicable, partially understood, or enduringly mysterious.
Whether the bond practices are shown functioning before the island fails to return, or only under pressure.
